methodology.clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC and CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID nanoseconds inside selected emitted C functions; Node performance.now process observations
methodology.scope: Single-thread Linux/GCC pendulum workflow; profiling changes optimization/instrumentation overhead. Control uses the same emitted C without instrumentation.
methodology.entryObservation: Launch-to-entry-marker delivery upper observation, including loader/scheduling/pipe/event-loop delay; not pure loader time.
methodology.residual: Process elapsed minus C-main inclusive time; includes launch, exit, stream transport, receipt and profiler teardown. Not pure startup time.
methodology.durations: Inclusive/exclusive phase samples are instrumented observations, never overhead-corrected or claimed as uninstrumented kernel time. Individual medians need not add up; each raw sample partitions its root interval exactly.
methodology.output: All control/profiled runs must match normalized interpreted report and SVG; zero live managed allocations required.
